intro_html: My Apps Dashboard gives every user a home screen of big app tiles: their favourite apps pinned on top, the apps the company relies on next, and the rest ordered by how often that person opens them, so nobody hunts through the app menu again.

features.title: Pin Your Favourites
features.desc: One click on the star moves an app into a Favorites row at the top.

features.title: Company Priority Apps
features.desc: An admin picks the apps everyone sees first, in a set order.

features.title: Sorted by Your Habits
features.desc: The apps you open most move up on their own.

features.title: Drag to Reorder
features.desc: Put any tile where you want it; your order is kept.

features.title: Find Any App Fast
features.desc: Type part of a name and the tiles filter instantly.

features.title: Your Start Screen, If You Want
features.desc: Each user, or an admin for everyone, can make it the first screen after login.

features.title: Never Grants Access
features.desc: Shows only the apps a user can already open.

features.title: Changes Nothing by Default
features.desc: Installing it doesn't change anyone's landing screen.

limitations: The admin's "everyone's home screen" switch applies once, when saved; users can change it back afterwards.
A home-screen change takes effect after the next login or page reload.
Usage counts how often an app is opened, not how long it's used.
A favourite for an app the user loses access to is hidden, not deleted.
